text.en: Most pet owners praise the veterinary team and front desk staff at the Hillington clinic for being polite, welcoming, and reassuring. Clients highlight Dr Hannah and Dr Alice for their compassionate and patient care during emergencies and end-of-life visits. However, two reviewers expressed frustration over perceived lack of veterinary expertise and felt commercial interests overshadowed patient care.

Clients frequently note how gently and calmly their cats and dogs are handled throughout consultations and treatments. Reviewers with nervous dogs or feisty cats appreciate that clinicians take the time to put animals at ease before administering vaccinations or health checks. Pet parents also mention receiving empathetic support during difficult euthanasia procedures.

Pet owners report positive recoveries following emergency visits and prompt medical care for sudden allergic reactions and acute pet illnesses. Reviewers appreciate when treatments are clearly explained with practical recovery options. Conversely, one client reported a deeply negative experience regarding extensive dental extractions that were carried out without prior discussion.

q.en: Can appointments be booked online at 3 Mile Veterinary Centre?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that booking appointments online is straightforward and convenient.

q.en: How do clients rate veterinary fees at the clinic?

a.en: Reviews regarding pricing are critical, with several clients describing consultations and procedures as expensive.

q.en: Does the practice handle emergency cases during opening hours?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the veterinary team accommodated urgent same-day visits before closing.

q.en: Is car parking available at the veterinary centre?

a.en: Yes, the practice is located on Colquhoun Avenue in Hillington Park Estate with dedicated parking available.
